recommendation: Do not promote anything from domain 7. No defense fix exists to promote, and B097 built no candidate and ran no jobs (the session was stopped by a safety classifier while reading the sources). The audit result is that the domain-7 card has no tested fix after waves 4, 6, 8 and 10. Prior evidence (B067) says no such hunter appears in the 2022-2025 pools, so the realistic field cost is about 0. Suggestion: close the card. Keep the existing B067 test case available for robustness checks, and do not hand this card to more agents.
